description.help: Text shown in the job menu.

unitType.help: Unit type the job turns the unit into; leave out for an overlay job that keeps the unit's class.

bonus.help: Stat bonus per stat while in this job.

requires.help: What unlocks this job; no loops. Each entry is { job, level }, { job, mastered, slot? } (that many of the job's learn entries) or { mastered: entry id }.

level.help: Level of that job needed (with job).

mastered.help: A number of that job's learn entries (with job), or the id of one entry that must be mastered (alone).

slot.help: Count only entries of this slot (with job and a number of mastered).

jpLevels.help: Own JP totals of the job levels, rising (replaces rules.jobs.jpLevels).

learn.help: Skills and abilities this job can teach (at most 40).

skill.help: A skill to learn (give skill or ability, not both).

cost.help: JP to learn it (required, and refused when rules.jobs.spendJp is false).
